name: Match 3 Rabbits
author: Addicting Games
description: Match 3 Rabbits is a puzzle game that is full of cute rabbits! These bunnies need a little bit of help getting organized and getting out of these columns. Click and hold on the rabbit you want to grab as you try to match 3, horizontally or vertically, to help the rabbits disappear. Bunnies in cages cannot be grabbed but they can be matched. You are not obligated to grab the bunny on top and can reach your hand down to grab a different one below. Each level has a goal that you must reach which you can find in the lower righthand corner. You only get a certain amount of lives per each level as indicated by the carrots in the upper righthand panel. There are 10 levels for you to pass in this online game! Grab a bunny and get to matchin’!
